settings.repere: Titre H3 · The helix structure of collagen
Paragraphe · If you zoom in on a single collagen prot
settings.text: If you zoom in on a single collagen protein, you’d see that it’s made up of 3 chains of amino acids tightly coiled around each other. This makes collagen very strong and flexible — so it can give strength and elasticity to the skin, plus support muscles, tendons, and bones.
